title: harness timeout-discipline guard fails at base on dumb-git-origin's 120s bound
body:
The harness node suite is red at the epic branch's base (e179e74c, reproduced with my changes stashed): the timeout-discipline guard classifies dumb-git-origin.test.ts's 'an origin that outlives the box carries the boot, the wip and the restore' as process-driving (real git, real bash) and demands a declared timeout of at least 300_000 ms, but the test declares 120_000. This fails `pnpm test` in harness — the CI job the epic close-out waits on for [A5] — independently of anything tick umx touched. The fix is the test's own declared bound, not the guard: raise that it()'s timeout to 300_000.
evidence: harness/test/node/dumb-git-origin.test.ts:140 (timeout: 120_000) vs harness/test/node/harness-timeout-discipline.test.ts:489-495; reproduced at base with: cd harness && pnpm exec vitest run -c vitest.node.config.ts test/node/harness-timeout-discipline.test.ts
